data.title: Income tax assessment 2026 with refund of €859.00
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterjena issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2026, setting tax at €6,744.00 against €7,603.00 withheld wage tax, resulting in a refund of €859.00 to be credited to the stated account.
data.explanation: This letter is your official 2026 income tax result from the Finanzamt. It shows you overpaid tax during the year, so €859.00 will be refunded to your bank account automatically within the next few days — no action is needed for the refund itself. If you believe any figure in the assessment (income, expenses, deductions) is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline by which it must arrive. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final. Keep this document for your records, as it may be relevant for future tax matters.
data.tax_note: This is the official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for the 2026 tax year; keep it together with your tax records.
